summary: With cliconf and terminal plugins in place, you can use cli_command for arbitrary commands and cli_config for config changes without platform-specific modules.
questions: How do I run arbitrary commands on a network device?
Can I configure a network device without a vendor module?

answer_card.title: Use cli_command and cli_config
answer_card.answer_md:
Once cliconf and terminal plugins exist for your OS:
- `cli_command` runs any command on the device.
- `cli_config` pushes configuration changes without a platform-specific module.
